Browser spellcheck is enabled

Typed pages reflow and your browser paginates them. Handwritten pages are laid out on the dot grid page by page (dashed lines show where each printed page ends); print with margins set to Default and scale at 100%. Included images are displayed locally. Remote images and raw HTML are not loaded.

Optional English pattern hints, not a full grammar checker. Browser spellcheck uses your browser's dictionary. Your wording is never changed automatically.

    ONE FORMAT. MANY WAYS IN.
    A journal that can change with you.
    01 / WORDS
    Write your way.
    Free writing, rapid logs, Markdown, dated entries and your own headings. No required daily file.
    02 / PAPER
    Paper when you want it.
    Print your pages handwritten on a dot grid (Look → Handwritten), and attach pictures of paper pages to keep them with the words.
    03 / STRUCTURE
    Make room for more.
    Optional measurements, prompts and diagram source live alongside prose. Inspect what the JavaScript parser sees.
    JOT v1 · WORKING PROTOTYPE
    The writing comes first.
    

    CHOOSE A WAY IN
    Methods, not obligations.
    55 original method adaptations. Insert a writing invitation and, if useful, an optional structured example. No source guide or commercial workbook is reproduced.
    

    KEEPING TRACK OF THE WHOLE
    The Jot roadmap.
    Implemented means code is present; tested means a check has passed. Prototype features still have limits.
